rows.name: Catalan numbers: C(n) = binomial(2n,n)/(n+1) = (2n)!/(n!(n+1)!).
Factorial numbers: n! = 1*2*3*4*...*n (order of symmetric group S_n, number of permutations of n letters).
Number of labeled semisimple rings with n elements.
Lucas numbers beginning at 2: L(n) = L(n-1) + L(n-2), L(0) = 2, L(1) = 1.
Lucas numbers (beginning with 1): L(n) = L(n-1) + L(n-2) with L(1) = 1, L(2) = 3.

Sorted list of Heinz numbers of collapsible integer partitions.

Number of 2 X 2 matrices having all terms in {1,...,n} and nonnegative even determinant.
Number of arrays of length n that are sums of 3 consecutive elements of length n+2 permutations of 0..n+1, and no two consecutive rises or falls in the latter permutation.
Least number k > 0 such that 2^k ends in exactly n consecutive increasing digits.
Number of level n squares on a Sierpinski carpet that intersect the edge of a circle with the same center and diameter.

Coordination sequence for "tsi" 3D uniform tiling.

Number of nXn 0..1 arrays with every element unequal to 0, 1, 2, 3, 7 or 8 king-move adjacent elements, with upper left element zero.

Start with a square of dimension 1 X 1, and repeatedly append along the squares of the previous step squares with half their side length that do not overlap with any prior square; a(n) gives the number of squares appended at n-th step.

Number of -6..6 arrays x(0..n-1) of n elements with zero sum, adjacent elements differing by more than one, and elements alternately increasing and decreasing.
Expansion of (Sum_{k>=0} x^(k^2*(k+1)^2/4))^12.
